integrity.proof_basis: Absolutely convergent beta-moment Hessian, four-point DFT, exact root-of-unity beta integrals, monotone single-crossing proof, and exact rational endpoint-sign certificate.
integrity.same_model_review_scope: Mathematical correctness, originality and value assessed against listed sources; no independent certification is asserted.

scientific_limitations: Only exactly four equally strong boundary poles, radial power weights and local second-order stability at equispacing are treated.
The all-parameter Hessian proof uses alpha>2; alpha=2 is used only as an endpoint of a continuous integral.
The numerical transition value is an approximation and not a certificate; the exact characterization is the unique zero of F.
Relevant indexed literature and original full texts were examined, but equivalence to unindexed findings cannot be ruled out.
title: Unique soft-mode transition for four boundary poles in power-weighted Bergman energy
